**Pre-release for field testing.** Windows transparent mode is now
available for field testing on Windows 10/11 (x64). Linux behavior is
unchanged from v1.0.0.

## Windows (Beta)

Download `dpi-proxy-windows-x86_64.zip`, extract it, open PowerShell
**as Administrator** in that folder and run:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
.\dpi-proxy-ctl status
```

Then use Discord, Chrome, Firefox, … normally — no proxy settings, no
DNS changes, no per-app configuration. If something fails:
`dpi-proxy-ctl diagnose discord.com` and `dpi-proxy-ctl logs 50`.
Uninstall: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\uninstall.ps1`.
See `WINDOWS-QUICKSTART.txt` in the ZIP.

The ZIP contains everything needed: `dpi-proxy.exe`, `dpi-proxy-ctl`,
`install.ps1`, `uninstall.ps1`, the WinDivert driver files and their
license, our LICENSE and the quick start. Nothing to build.

WinDivert is a third-party, signed packet interception driver
(LGPLv3/GPLv2), shipped unmodified; antivirus software may warn about
it. Stop GoodbyeDPI, zapret, other DPI tools and VPN packet filters
before testing.

### Validated (automated end-to-end test on real Windows machines — GitHub runners — with the real WinDivert driver)

- Windows service install and start
- real WinDivert interception
- HTTPS interception
- DNS-over-HTTPS for all DNS
- the bypass path (TLS record fragmentation)
- restart
- crash → fail-open, then automatic restart
- uninstall (only our own state removed)
- no redirect loops

### Still pending

- real ISP DPI validation
- IPv6
- QUIC behavior on real blocked networks
- performance on consumer Windows machines

## Linux

Unchanged transparent automatic mode (field-tested on real ISP DPI).
Internally it now shares the platform layer with Windows; the same
end-to-end test (install, interception, DoH, bypass, stop, crash
fail-open, uninstall) runs on every build. One behavioral refinement:
the certificate verifier now runs in-process instead of via
`openssl s_client`, and only an invalid certificate — not a network
error — marks a direct connection as bad.

## Assets

- `dpi-proxy-windows-x86_64.zip` — Windows transparent mode (Beta) + SOCKS5
- `dpi-proxy-linux-x86_64` — Linux binary (install from source with `scripts/install.sh`)
- `dpi-proxy-macos-arm64` — SOCKS5 proxy
- `SHA256SUMS`
